description: This file implements a server for an IPC (Inter-Process Communication) service using protobufs and a custom IPC framework. It defines a service class with methods for echoing text, handling file descriptors, and no-reply calls, along with client connection and disconnection handlers, and a main function that sets up and runs the server.

classes.name: MyExampleServiceServer
classes.description: A server class implementing the example::ExampleService interface, providing methods for echoing text, handling file descriptors, and no-reply calls.

methods.name: exampleEcho
methods.description: Converts the request text to uppercase and responds with it, logging the request and response.

methods.name: exampleWithFd
methods.description: Sends a message to a file descriptor provided in the request and responds with the server’s stdout file descriptor.

methods.name: exampleWithNoReply
methods.description: Logs a message indicating a no-reply request; does not send a response.
